quality_comparisons.objective_verifier: The capability instruction requires verified facts, unresolved assumptions, blockers, and next intent to be recorded as separate fields and forbids promoting an unsupported claim to a fact.

The capability instruction requires the receiver to compare repository, exact revision, and managed task/OpenSpec identity first and to treat a mismatch (moved HEAD, rebase, superseded task) as stale, re-reading canonical sources.

The capability instruction states that creating or receiving a handoff performs no GitHub/Backlog/Project/OpenSpec/worktree mutation and grants no execution authority, and that it composes with the existing provider routing record rather than duplicating executor selection or containment.
The deterministic fixture contains ten hard-negative prompts (same-context compact, existing task state, ordinary quick tasks, executor routing) and verifies that none trigger a handoff envelope.
